compactLyrics.setting: Show lyrics in the collapsed notch
compactLyrics.hint: On: while Spotify plays, the collapsed notch shows the current lyric line. Off, for other players, or when no lyrics are found: it shows the song title and artist.
compactLyrics.keywords: lyrics karaoke song title artist singer collapsed compact notch pill now playing
tabs.position.hint: Keep the page tabs inside the notch, or move them to a pill below or beside it that appears while you point at the open notch.
tabs.size.hint: Size of the tabs pill below or beside the notch.
tabs.keywords: tabs navigation pages position bottom left right size pill hover
